proposed:
When `Sp = 1`, the expression reduces to `τ = π/Se`. **`Se` is not estimated.** Because detector sensitivity cannot exceed 1, `τ = π/Se ≥ π`; under the specificity measured in §4.1, the observed flag rate is therefore a conservative floor on true prevalence with respect to machine text the detector misses.

That conclusion requires a transfer assumption. Specificity is measured on each chamber's pre-2022 record, while the permeation result shows contemporary human speech drifting toward the register on which the detector relies. Thus, `Sp = 1` for human speech in 2025–26 is assumed rather than measured. Section 4.1 bounds the cost of that assumption at no more than about 0.2 points under the harshest reading of the audited hits; the Limits return to it.
rationale: The current paragraph states the caveat only after a categorical claim that every estimate is conservative. Moving the transfer condition into its own paragraph preserves the lower-bound argument while making its scope immediately clear.
